messages.python.help:
Standalone Creator (Python 3.10+, Node.js 22+, Windows).
From the extracted Creator folder:
python Start-Skin.py configure --proxy-mode direct
python Start-Skin.py
python Create-Skin.py start --session work/my-skin --state <managed-session.json> --id my-skin --name "My Skin"
Choose proxy instead of direct when needed. All runtime services are included in this package; no sibling package is required.

messages.recovery.case.titlebar.title: Topbar background gap
messages.recovery.case.titlebar.symptom: The painted topbar ends before the visible content boundary; solid, gradient and shared-image branches may differ.
messages.recovery.case.titlebar.action: Run diagnose --slot titlebar. Use only visible nonzero non-inert references. Extend the owned background layer for the active paint branch, never native buttons or dragging geometry.
messages.recovery.case.titlebar.verify: Verify solid, gradient and shared-image paths at normal/maximized sizes; the native diagnostic must cover the gap with pointer-inert decoration.
messages.recovery.case.viewport.title: Window measurement changed after resizing
messages.recovery.case.viewport.symptom: A native placement acknowledgement can precede the final viewport dimensions.
messages.recovery.case.viewport.action: Use bounded geometry stability sampling and compare capture dimensions. Retain old evidence; do not replace it with monitor resolution or a manually edited success.
messages.recovery.case.viewport.verify: Verify late dimension changes, timeout/restoration and actual stable native geometry.
messages.recovery.case.control-role.title: Separate-image control region rejected
messages.recovery.case.control-role.symptom: A static shared-scene candidate list was mistaken for actual image regions in every form.
messages.recovery.case.control-role.action: Determine image roles from the selected form. Unified scene regions retain images; separate chat/sidebar retain images while other selected regions accept independent controls.
messages.recovery.case.control-role.verify: Verify both forms, preserved background acceptance and atomic rejection of low-contrast or missing-foreground choices.
messages.recovery.case.backplate.title: Native inner backplate hides the Skin
messages.recovery.case.backplate.symptom: An outer popup color does not establish the visible inner surface color.
messages.recovery.case.backplate.action: Inspect the actual inner component and its pseudo-elements. Apply scoped surface variables to that mapped component, preserving semantic foregrounds; do not globally recolor descendants.
messages.recovery.case.backplate.verify: Reopen the native popup and audit rendered neutral text/icons over the actual solid surface.
messages.recovery.case.focus.title: Inventory paused on an editable field
messages.recovery.case.focus.symptom: A focused composer or Settings search prevents safe navigation.
messages.recovery.case.focus.action: Preserve the draft. Use permitted UI control to click an observed blank header, then retry the same inventory step; do not read, clear or submit the field.
messages.recovery.case.focus.verify: Verify focus moved without content changes and original navigation/window restoration succeeded.
messages.recovery.case.color-cast.title: Artwork looks too purple or tinted
messages.recovery.case.color-cast.symptom: Identical files/decoded pixels do not prove the final visual palette is appropriate.
messages.recovery.case.color-cast.action: Compare unobstructed parts of a user screenshot against source art with the actual overlay. Distinguish source palette, decode, composite and display effects before correcting the responsible stage.
messages.recovery.case.color-cast.verify: Preserve originals and identities. Review the corrected asset and actual preview; user visual acceptance remains required.
messages.recovery.found: Relevant recovery guidance; verify against the current state.
messages.recovery.noMatch: No matching recovery case; retain observations without guessing a fix.
messages.recovery.recorded: Appended a private recovery record; this does not create consent or reset failure counts.
messages.recovery.case.foreground.title: Explicit foreground does not reach a native label
messages.recovery.case.foreground.symptom: The parent color is correct but a native label uses its own secondary/tertiary or component color variable.
messages.recovery.case.foreground.action: Inspect the reported region and actual computed foreground, including hover/closed-menu states. Map only its neutral foreground variables or the specific monochrome symbol variable; preserve semantic colors.
messages.recovery.case.foreground.verify: Keep neutral text at 4.5:1 and monochrome icons at 3:1. Check actual hover and normal states, preserve drafts and semantic status colors, and do not lower thresholds.
messages.recovery.unavailable: Recovery guidance is unavailable; the original failed result and evidence remain valid.
messages.recovery.case.semantic-meter.title: Semantic meter mistaken for a monochrome icon
messages.recovery.case.semantic-meter.symptom: A data meter can use warning colors or neutral gray/white while retaining the same semantic role.
messages.recovery.case.semantic-meter.action: Use a verified version-specific semanticGraphics selector for the meter SVG only. Keep its separate ordinary symbol checked; do not recolor the track or skip the whole navigation/button.
messages.recovery.case.semantic-meter.verify: Exercise warning and neutral states, retain a failing ordinary white icon on white, and manually preserve readable data/status colors.
messages.recovery.case.client-version.title: Client updated during Skin creation
messages.recovery.case.client-version.symptom: The verified Store client, injected adapter and saved inventory no longer have the same complete version.
messages.recovery.case.client-version.action: Compare all three versions and the payload hash. Preserve old profiles and art; add and inspect a separate exact-version profile. Do not guess a nearby version or weaken the guard.
messages.recovery.case.client-version.verify: Run old/new version selection and rejection checks, re-inventory the actual new client, and verify native controls before accepting or exporting.
messages.recovery.case.footer.title: Native footer fade hides the chat background
messages.recovery.case.footer.symptom: The source floor is sharp but a dark blurred strip appears outside the composer; footer pseudo-elements can paint separate gradients and solid fills.
messages.recovery.case.footer.action: Compare source art with computed before/after footer styles. Clear only proven decorative fills inside the matching version chat region. Preserve the composer and native hits; do not hide a renderer mask with outpainting or blur-fill.
messages.recovery.case.footer.verify: Check both pseudo-elements are transparent without background images, inspect normal/maximized continuous ground, and verify composer/attachment hits plus restoration.
